activity_summary: After Titus, in the parlour, Burbage said your voice had held. The cold is gone. Kemp was civil and did not ask for a new laugh. You and Burbage counted seventeen days to Thursday the twentieth for Berowne, which is not three weeks. Heminges will take Nick to a Cheapside mercer tomorrow and call you when the man has named a price. He did not name one today. The Queen's twenty pounds are still not had. Edith's eight shillings stay unpaid, and they are not your purse. You mean to ask Field in the morning about a chronicle for Lent, and not to take it yet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Counted the days and set the chronicle aside until Lent.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Heard the voice and named the seventeen days.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Stayed civil and stayed off the new play's ending.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Promised the Cheapside errand and refused to invent a price.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Named as the boy to be measured tomorrow. He was not in the parlour.

facets.activity: Heard Heminges will call with the mercer's price

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Thou hast thy voice back, Will.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Seventeen days to the twentieth, Will.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I will call you, Will, when the man has named his figure.
